question_text: Construct 3NF tables with keys for these facts: A product has unique ProductID, Name, SupplierID and UnitPrice; each supplier has one SupplierName and Region; each store stocks many products with a Quantity specific to(StoreID, ProductID). Show primary and foreign keys.
adaptation_rationale: Preserve multi-store normalization with explicitly stated dependencies and atomic fields. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Supplier(SupplierID PK, SupplierName, Region); Product(ProductID PK, Name, SupplierID FK→Supplier, UnitPrice); Stock(StoreID PKpart, ProductID PKpart/FK→Product, Quantity). A Store table may be included if additional store facts are defined.

marking_points.criterion: Product table with ProductID primary key.
Quantity stored only on Stock and ProductID linked to Product.
